versions.content: The Dlt_TxFunction shall check the status of the flag, which indicates that a BufferOverflow occurred:  If a buffer overflow occurred, the Dlt command “BufferOverflowNotification” shall be sent only once, until the overflow flag is cleared again.  After a time interval given by the parameter DltLogChannelBufferOverflowTimer, the buffer overflow flag shall be cleared. This shall be done for every configured LogChannel separately.
